text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —And so, an exhibition race will be held as one of the event's segments.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And the two of us were specifically nominated as runners! What an honor!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whether it's sprint or mile, our fierce battle is sure to get everyone hyped up!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Actually, no... The exhibition race distance is set to 1200m—short sprint only.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What?! Short sprint only!? Even though both of us are participating!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's a race within a corporate event, after all... The organizers might not be very familiar with racing.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, there's no problem at all.
I won't lose in sprints, either.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In fact, it's a wonderful opportunity
to steal Bakushin O-chan's spotlight—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This is simply not fair!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let us make haste, Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! Where are we going?!
Bakushin O-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way to the trainer's office,
I spotted a horse girl sprinting at tremendous speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—To negotiate directly with the organizers!
We must have them add a mile race as well!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are we going by ourselves?!
If we do something like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They vanished in the blink of an eye...
Was it really okay to let them go?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, both of you...!
Phew... What incredible speed...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, perfect timing!
I'm worried about them.
Could you please go after them?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after them by taxi, I arrived at the organizer's
headquarters. The two of them were trying to negotiate
directly with the event staff.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
!! Please set up a mile category
in the event race as well!!

text_block_list.name: Event Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Aren't sprints and miles barely that
different anyway...? Surely just one is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, they are completely different!! Allow me to explain
the profound difference between a sprint and a mile!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A sprint is BAKUSHIIIIIIIN!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A mile is, ooooh~ BAKUSHIIIIIN!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That is the difference!!
Do you understand now?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm... Allow me to—
choice_data_list: Excuse me. Please let me explain.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...!! Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I passionately explained the distinct charms of sprints and miles.
Thanks to that, they agreed to establish
a mile race alongside the sprint.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right! They agreed to set up a mile race!
Now things are completely fair!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will challenge Flight-san in the mile
and snatch victory away! Wahaha!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So that's what you meant by fair...
Fufu, that's so like you, Bakushin O-chan.
choice_data_list: You two have a great rivalry.
You two have a wonderful rivalry.
I can't wait for the event race!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So that's what you meant by fair...
Fufu, that's so like you, Bakushin O-chan.
choice_data_list: You two have a great rivalry.
You two have a wonderful rivalry.
I can't wait for the event race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why, of course! Flight-san is
an absolutely indispensable presence to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am presently thriving in sprint races,
but eventually I shall conquer medium, long,
and all manner of racing distances!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thus, the mile comes first! For I cannot
advance without defeating Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A towering, steep wall!! Yet one
I will undoubtedly surpass! Just you watch, Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I won't let you get over me
that easily, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, I promise you a heated showdown!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Not just the races, but I feel like we could
liven up the entire event even more.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
For example, by helping people understand
the differences between sprints and miles...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, marvelous! For the greater
prosperity of sprints and miles!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then let us draft a proposal and present it to them!
My passion is burning bright~~!!
